home.title: The Pillars of Creation
home.what_body: Hubble image of the Eagle Nebula (M16), known as the “Pillars of Creation”. These tendrils of dust and gas are part of an active star-forming region and hide newborn stars. The colors map elements: blue (oxygen), red (sulfur) and green (nitrogen + hydrogen). Spanning 4–5 light-years within a 70 × 55 light-years nebula, it lies about 7000 light-years away in the constellation Serpens.
home.credits: Credits: NASA, ESA and the Hubble Heritage Team (STScI/AURA).

contact.about_body: Three friends, one infinite canvas. Our wplace project is a digital mural of over 250,000 pixels where we shape the Pillars of Creation. We’re not just painting, we’re leaving a grain of stardust in this digital cosmos, uniting ambition, art, and community.
